exact: regulation of branching involved in salivary gland morphogenesis by mesenchymal-epithelial signalling

definition: Any process that modulates the rate, frequency, or extent of branching involved in salivary gland morphogenesis as a result of signals being generated by the mesenchyme and received and interpreted by the salivary gland epithelium.
label: regulation of branching involved in salivary gland morphogenesis by mesenchymal-epithelial signaling
